title: Perturbation of hyperthermia resistance in gastric cancer by hyperstimulation of autophagy using artemisinin-protected iron-oxide nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34565-34577
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05611F, Paper
Open Access

Komal Attri, Bhupendra Chudasama, Roop L. Mahajan, Diptiman Choudhury
In a bid to overcome hyperthermia resistance, a major obstacle in cancer treatment, this study explores manipulating autophagy, a cellular recycling mechanism, within the context of gastric cancer.
